solutions.title: Flatten sliding window
solutions.strategy: Flatten values with their list id, sort them, and shrink a window covering every list.

timeComplexity.explanation: All N values are sorted before the window pass.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The flattened array and frequency map are stored.

solutions.title: Min heap
solutions.strategy: Keep one pointer per list in a min-heap and track the current maximum.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value is pushed and popped at most once from a heap of k lists.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap stores one active value per list.
